package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// StudentPlanningReadinessReader is read-only and returns one consistent,
// bounded Student-owned source snapshot for planning.
type StudentPlanningReadinessReader interface {
	ReadPlanningReadiness(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource, error)
}
